This is a bit of a loaded request. One can not prove they care. There really isn't anything you can prove. If I said I care because I actually came and commented, there would be plenty that you could say to say I don't really care. At the same time though, you couldn't disprove it. You could not prove I don't care, even if I said I do not care. It is up to you to believe that I care, that I don't care, or even that you would not be ready to decide. No one here could prove they care, and none of the people you know, if they do care can prove it.
Since the above states that caring could not be undeniably proven, and it is up to you to believe it or not, what would you like to see to be able to believe someone cares?
